rules.source: FDA clopidogrel (Plavix) label, warning on CYP2C19 inhibitors: avoid omeprazole or esomeprazole
rules.text: Omeprazole blocks CYP2C19, the enzyme that activates clopidogrel, and can lower clopidogrel's effect. The clopidogrel label advises avoiding this combination; worth raising with the pharmacist or cardiologist.
